scenicChapters.title: Inverness → Bealach na Ba
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 120 km. 626 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: North Coast 500
scenicChapters.narrative: 626 m come off over 5 km at around 13.2%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

north-coast-500-inverness-dunrobin-castl.story: A 555 km one-way ride from near Inverness, about 8 h 59 of riding. The stops in between: Bealach na Ba, Applecross, Ullapool and Durness. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

legend-romania-transalpina.slogan: Romania Transalpina – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-romania-transalpina.story: curated scenic road. Carpathian ridge, high plateau, hairpins. From Novaci it runs 87 km to Sebeş; allow about 1 h 35 of riding. The highest point is about 2,150 m. Urdele Pass is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Romania Transalpina
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 9 km this is Romania Transalpina, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

uludag-ascent.title: Uludağ Ascent
uludag-ascent.slogan: From Bursa up the Mysian Olympus: two thousand metres gained on a paved road, with the plain behind you the whole way.

waypoints.name: Bursa
waypoints.advice: Bursa is where the day begins. Next is Sarıalan, climbing 1530 m.

waypoints.name: Sarıalan
waypoints.advice: Sarıalan comes up 22 km in. The road climbs 1530 m on the way up to it, hard. Next is Uludağ, climbing 270 m.

waypoints.name: Uludağ
waypoints.advice: 1900 m, and the road stops climbing. The road climbs 270 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 12 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Çekirge, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Çekirge
waypoints.advice: Çekirge closes the day.

sections.advice: Bursa → Sarıalan, 15 km, climbing about 1530 m. Part of Uludağ Ascent.
Sarıalan → Uludağ, 6 km. Part of Uludağ Ascent.
Uludağ → Çekirge, 25 km. Part of Uludağ Ascent.

uludag-ascent.provenance: MANUAL SEED: every stop was entered by hand from a known position on the road. The distance is the seed figure, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces it. Altitudes are present only where they were known; the rest are null rather than zero.

scenicChapters.title: Uludağ Ascent
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 10.6%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Uludağ Ascent
scenicChapters.narrative: 1900 m come off over 36 km at around 7.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

uludag-ascent.story: 66 km from Bursa to Bursa, about 1 h 16 of riding. Uludağ is the high point. It tops out at 1,900 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
